title: Droplet Open Ring
descriptionHtml:
A ball and a drop, almost touching. An open ring of smooth polished wire that swells at one end into a round ball and at the other into a long teardrop, the two sitting side by side on top of the finger. Open at the back, so it adjusts to fit. In warm gold or bright silver tone; pairs with the Droplet Open Cuff.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Droplet Open Cuff in the same metal.

Details

  • Style: Adjustable open ring
  • Ends: A round ball, approximately 7mm, and a long teardrop, approximately 9mm
  • Fit: Open at the back, so it adjusts to fit
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated or rhodium plated silver tone (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
